name: Island of Mozambique
description: This small coral island off northern Mozambique was a Portuguese trading post on the sea route to India, and it served as the capital of Portuguese East Africa until 1898. Its fortified town, still home to about 14,000 people, has kept a remarkably uniform look of stone buildings and thatched macuti roofs dating back to the 16th century. The country takes its name from the island, which also has sandy beaches.
